title: LIST OF IAF HONORARY RANKS AWARDED ON THE OCCASION  OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
body_text:
List of Honorary Commission (Honorary Flying Officer and Honorary Flight Lieutenant) awarded on the occasion of Independence Day 2026 is enclosed.
List of Hony Flight Lieutant Rank (Total 82)
List of Hony Flying Officer (Total 328)
List of Hony Flying Officer on retirement (Total 07)
***
VK/JS/SM

enrichment.summary: The Ministry of Defence released the list of Indian Air Force personnel awarded Honorary Commission ranks on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. This includes 82 personnel granted the Honorary Flight Lieutenant rank, 328 granted the Honorary Flying Officer rank, and 7 given the Honorary Flying Officer rank on retirement.
enrichment.context: Honorary commissions are ceremonial ranks conferred on select senior non-commissioned officers (Warrant Officers/Master Warrant Officers) of the Indian Air Force, typically on Republic Day and Independence Day, as a mark of distinction for long and meritorious service. These are traditional annual gallantry/service honours administered by the Ministry of Defence and do not carry command authority but confer the status and privileges of a commissioned officer to deserving senior airmen nearing or past retirement. This is a routine, recurring administrative announcement with no new policy, scheme, or systemic change involved.
